meta.source: Baseball Savant pitch-level data held in this repo (models/data/pitches_{2025,2026}.parquet): regular-season batted balls (description = hit_into_play) with a recorded exit velocity and launch angle
meta.selection: 36 hitters with 300+ batted balls in 2026, chosen at even steps through the 2026 average exit velocity order so the set spans soft to hard contact (not a ranking and not a best-of list)
fields: batting side of that event (0 left, 1 right)
result (0 out or other, 1 single, 2 double, 3 triple, 4 home run)
xwOBA on that batted ball x1000 (-1 = none)
